desc: UI sprite atlas: rectangle of a UI texture (.txf in Start_*.dat/Texture*) per sprite id, with one rect set per language (75 rows differ: EN/FR text-bearing graphics). PC exe picks the slot by game language (0=JP,1=EN,2=FR); language ids 3/4 are remapped to slot 1, so CHN/KOR slots appear unused on PC. Relevant for new units: face icons live in wf_*_48px/64px.txf with ids 10836-12469 (which id a unit uses is computed by code, no char.dat field holds a TextureDataBase id). Adding a row beyond 13172 or a new texture requires an exe patch; editing rects/pixels of existing ids does not. Rect maxima exceed some Texture_opt txf sizes (those are downscaled variants).
